data.name: Nazra
data.gender_notes: Nazra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: to see, to observe, to perceive, to understand. The name Nazra carries the meaning “insight, observation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Nazra usually hope their child will grow to embody insight, observation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: a name for one who possesses deep insight and wisdom, one who can perceive the unseen and understand the hidden meanings of things
data.etymology: Nazra belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “insight, observation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nazra total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: نَزْرَة
in_arabic.long_meaning: النَزْرَة أَنَظَمُ الطَلا وَالشَمس وَهِيَ كَمَوقِعٍ يُنظَرُ إِلى طَلا وَبَعضِ النَظَرِ إِلى الشَمسِ، وَبِالرَسمِ النَظَرُ مَعناهُ تَنظُرُ النَاظِرُ إِلى شَيءٍ بِإِعجابِهِ، فَنَزْرَةُ الطَلا وَالشَمسِ هِيَ تَنظُرُ إِلى طَلا بِإِعجابِها وَتَنظُرُ إِلى الشَمسِ بِإِعجابِها، وَالنَزْرَةُ هِيَ الأَعلى وَالأَنَظَمُ فَأَيُّ نَزْرَةِ الطَلا وَالشَمسِ هِيَ الأَعلى وَالأَنَظَمُ، وَهِيَ لِأَنَّها أَنَظَمُ الطَلا وَالشَمسِ كَمَوقِعٍ يُنظَرُ إِلى طَلا وَبَعضِ النَظَرِ إِلى الشَمسِ

in_urdu.name: نُزْرہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نُزْرہ انظَم طَلٰہ اور شمس ہے، یہ وہ مقام ہے جہاں طَلٰہ اور شمس کو دیکھا جاتا ہے، اور اس میں بعض دیکھنے کا بھی ہوتا ہے، اور رسم کے مطابق دیکھنے کا معنی ہے کہ دیکھنے والا کسی چیز کو دیکھ کر خوش ہو جاتا ہے، اور اس صورت میں دیکھنے والا طَلٰہ کو خوش ہو کر دیکھتا ہے اور شمس کو بھی خوش ہو کر دیکھتا ہے، اور دیکھنے والا ہے سب سے اُچا اور سب سے انظَم، لہذا جس دیکھنے میں طَلٰہ اور شمس کو دیکھا جاتا ہے، وہ ہے سب سے اُچا اور سب سے انظَم

in_hindi.name: नु़ज़्रह
in_hindi.long_meaning: नु़ज़्रह अन्थम तिल और सूरज है, यह वो स्थान है जहॉं तिल और सूरज को देखा जाता है, और इसमें कुछ देखने का भी होता है, और व्याकरण के अनुसार देखने का अर्थ है कि देखने वाला किसी चीज़ को देखकर खुश हो जाता है, और इसी तरह देखने वाला तिल को खुश होकर देखता है और सूरज को भी खुश होकर देखता है, और देखने वाला है सबसे ऊंचा और सबसे अन्थम, इसलिए जिस देखने में तिल और सूरज को देखा जाता है, वह सबसे ऊंचा और सबसे अन्थम है

in_pashto.name: نُزرې
in_pashto.long_meaning: نُزرې انظَم طَلٰہ او شمس ېډې وې، یې وې چېرې څه څه د طَلٰہ او شمس څخه ویني، په دی دې څه څه څخه څېرمه په دی هغه څه څخه د دیکه کولای شي، دی دې څه څخه د دیکه لوړی او انظَمو څخه ده

in_english.name: Nazra
in_english.meaning: The most beautiful aspect of the sun and the moon, gazing at the sun and a part of the sun
in_english.long_meaning: Nazra is the most beautiful aspect of the sun and the moon, gazing at the sun and a part of the sun. In Arabic, the word "nazra" means to gaze at something with admiration. Therefore, gazing at the sun and a part of the sun is an act of admiration, making it the most beautiful and highest aspect. This name is significant in Islamic tradition, symbolizing the beauty and wonder of creation.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل

data.cultural_impact: The name "Nazra" signifies a keen eye for awareness in the Islamic culture. In Arabic, the term "Nazara" is used to describe an observant person who remains vigilant and pays attention to their surroundings. In Islamic tradition, this term is often associated with righteousness and moral consciousness.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, "Nazra" implies a deep understanding of the Divine and the world around us. It's a reminder of the importance of observation and reflection in our spiritual journey. Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Verily, the understanding of the religion is in four things: to listen and understand and to reflect upon that which has been heard, and to practice that which has been learned." (Bukhari and Muslim) By embodying the virtue of Nazra, one can develop a stronger connection with Allah through mindfulness and a heightened awareness of the signs of His existence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "insight, observation" symbolizes to see, to observe, to perceive, to understand. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Nazra serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of insight, observation.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Nazra bint Mundhir ibn Sawa was a poetess and a sister of the famous poet Imru' al-Qais. The name Nazra carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Nazra was a poetess and a sister of the famous poet Imru' al-Qais, who is known for his pre-Islamic and early Islamic poetry.
